description: Tool to retrieve paginated line items for a payment link. Use when you need to get detailed product and service information including quantities, prices, discounts, and taxes for a specific payment link.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving payment link line items.

ending_before.description: Cursor for backward pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list; returns results before this line item.

payment_link.description: The unique identifier of the payment link to retrieve line items for.
payment_link.title: Payment Link

starting_after.description: Cursor for forward pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list; returns results after this line item.
starting_after.title: Starting After
